input.change_text: Added `close()` method to Query interface for forcefully terminating running queries

output.subject: close() method on Query interface
output.action_text: Upgrade to `claude-agent-sdk-typescript` 0.2.15+ to call `close()` on a `Query` for forceful termination of an in-flight run. Wire it into your abort/cleanup paths so timeouts and user-cancel signals stop the underlying CLI subprocess instead of leaking it.
